ward_limit: Not essential. Not a survival drug. Class IIb in ESC 2024 CCS. Absent from AHA 2023 CCD. Do not use in Parkinson disease, pregnancy, breastfeeding, or creatinine clearance below 30 mL/min.
one_sentence: Angina is a mismatch, not only a tight artery. This drug changes fuel use when you cannot lower demand further. Europe allows that at Class IIb.

groups.title: Slides 1 to 5 — leftover angina
groups.bridge: The early slides are about the patient, not the molecule.

claims.claim: Trimetazidine is an essential part of therapy.
claims.say: It may be considered as add-on, or in a selected first combination, Class IIb.
claims.locator: ESC 2024 CCS PDF p16 Table 4. Harrison L2-634 says second-line, not essential.
claims.if_asked: Essential is the slide title, not the guideline.

claims.claim: 40% said angina affected quality of life completely or very much. BRIDGE 2.
claims.say: Leftover angina is a real burden. The 40% is that survey.
claims.if_asked: Quality of life is why symptom drugs exist. The percentage is not a textbook fact.

claims.claim: Angina at 1 year linked to 32% higher cardiovascular death or infarction. CLARIFY.
claims.say: Persistent symptoms mark higher risk. This figure does not prove the drug prevents those deaths.
claims.locator: Slide 3. Direction without 32%: Harrison L2-622, Davidson L2-164.
claims.ward: Do not claim a mortality benefit.

groups.title: Slides 6 to 12 — not one blocked artery
groups.bridge: Ischaemia is a mismatch. A tight stenosis is the usual cause, not the only one.

claims.claim: CCS is a transient demand-supply mismatch from arteries and/or microcirculation.
claims.locator: ESC 2024 CCS PDF p9-10. Davidson L2-155. Harrison L2-610. Kumar L2-280.
claims.ward: A definition is not a licence to call every chest pain ischaemia.
claims.if_asked: Disease is the pathology. Syndrome is the presentation.

claims.say: Davidson says 10-20% of effort angina have normal coronaries. Selected no-obstruction meta-analysis: about 41% microvascular and 40% vasospastic.
claims.locator: Davidson L2-156. ESC 2024 CCS PDF p31.
claims.ward: Do not say Davidson or the guideline sentence is 50%.
claims.if_asked: The slide graphic and the retrieved sentences are different facts.

claims.say: Nitrates act on large vessels and preload. They relieve spasm acutely. Isolated spasm: calcium-channel blocker, Class I, Level A.
claims.locator: Harrison L2-658. ESC 2024 CCS PDF p15.
claims.ward: Do not repeat the endothelium clause as a book fact.
claims.if_asked: The wrong first drug in isolated spasm is the beta-blocker.

groups.title: Slides 15 to 18 — metabolism
groups.bridge: Defend the direction of the fuel shift. Do not defend the percentage.

claims.say: Harrison states the shift from fatty-acid oxidation toward glucose. The percentage is Filmore 2014 on the slide.
claims.ward: Do not attribute +33% to Harrison or ESC.
claims.if_asked: How much more ATP? The textbook does not give a percentage.

groups.title: Slides 43 and 44 — class change
groups.bridge: The downgrade is printed. The congress anecdote is not.

claims.claim: Class moved from IIa to IIb.
claims.say: Nicorandil or trimetazidine may be considered, Class IIb. Nitrates and ranolazine stayed IIa.
claims.locator: ESC 2024 CCS PDF p16 Table 4. Gap: PDF p84.
claims.if_asked: Do not say the PDF declares the downgrade illegitimate.

claims.say: AHA 2023 does not list trimetazidine and uses ranolazine. Ivabradine is Class 3 Harm if the ventricle is normal.
claims.ward: Do not translate a European IIb into an American recommendation.
claims.if_asked: Say AHA does not endorse this deck.

questions.a: Table 4 downgraded it, and the guideline admits the ladder is not proved.
questions.locator: ESC 2024 CCS PDF p16 and p84.
ESC 2024 CCS PDF p46. Davidson L2-165.
